```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(here)

source(here("R", "od_io.R"))
```

```{r}
build_od_parquet()
od <- open_od()
```

```{r}
selected_months <- c(
          202206, 202209, 202212,
  202303, 202306, 202309, 202312,
  202403, 202406, 202409, 202412,
  202503, 202506, 202509, 202512,
  202603, 202606, 202609
  )

total_bus <- od %>%
  filter(
    MODE == "bus",
    YYYYMM %in% selected_months,
    DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY",
    TIME_PER_HOUR %in% 6:9
    ) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
subzone <- read_sf(
  here("data", "raw", "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson")
  ) %>%
  st_transform(3414)

busStops <- read_sf(
  here("data", "raw", "LTABusStop.geojson")
  ) %>%
  st_transform(3414)

hub_zones <- list(
  CBD = c(
    "PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE",
    "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL",
    "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS",
    "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL"
    ),

  `Jurong East` = c(
    "JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK",
    "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)"
    ),

  Woodlands = c(
    "NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE"
    ),

  Tampines = c(
    "TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST"
    )
  )

hub_subzones <- bind_rows(
  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$CBD) %>%
    mutate(zone = "CBD"),

  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$`Jurong East`) %>%
    mutate(zone = "Jurong East"),

  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$Woodlands) %>%
    mutate(zone = "Woodlands"),

  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$Tampines) %>%
    mutate(zone = "Tampines")
  )

dict_hub_stop <- st_join(
  busStops,
  hub_subzones %>% select(zone),
  join = st_intersects,
  left = FALSE
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(BUS_STOP_NUM, zone) %>%
  distinct()
```
